keyFindings.description: The in-flight push across a flip back to consumer delivery is still lost. The relay acks its consumer copy on the attempt record, irrevocably, but the worker keeps pushing only while relayAcksOnAnAttempt re-reads that record. Loss when the record expires (attemptCacheTTL 5 min from hand-over, never refreshed) or the worker hands back on servePortGone (durable redelivery then skipped since the consumer holds the sequence). Tests that must fail: TestServePortPushInFlightReachesThePortAcrossAFlipBackToConsumer with attemptCache.Clear (or a clock past attemptCacheTTL) after awaitAcked; and with sessions.Delete then re-register after awaitAcked. Fix: the relay holds (NAK with delay / in progress) on followedTopicAttempted instead of acking, pushes itself once the attempt clears or expires, acks once a dedupe record appears; the worker then drops on Relayed as before.

The agent path turns Relayed into Delivered+Skipped and agentSubjectDelivery records attempt and dedupe for a message only the relay delivers, against the comments at session.go:62-66 and :88-93. No loss today (control topics are never refused by the relay).
